answer: Compute a per-identity jade score from behavioural fingerprints logged across epochs. Rule: an identity's jade score at epoch N must stay within a tolerance band of its trailing median over the prior K epochs, checked at each atlas of settled actions. Violating the band triggers review and freezes payouts. An attacker running many sock puppets must sustain consistent, costly behaviour on every identity up to the zenith threshold, multiplying their operational spend per fake agent.
